text: The slot holds the head `discriminant + sentences` for `bioclip2-l14` (shrinkage 0.3, species_sci, gamma 3), fitted on `images/alachua-pre2025`, with 5911 species rows, and a bias a row. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 0.5, w_kind 0.7, alpha_prior 1.2. On 1803 tuning photos (val) the thresholds came out as name_at 0.05 and offer_at never (no level reached nine in ten). On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 98.1% (97.7 to 98.5); the top species is right for 92.7% (91.9 to 93.5) and is among the first five for 97.5% (97.0 to 97.9). `person` was said for 0.12% of these photos and `none` for 0.05%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind rows fitted on the fitting photos and the extra set (every photo counts the same)`. With kind_at 0.20 (set on wildlife tuning photos and the extra set's tuning third), the page asserts a kind for 99.9% (99.7 to 100.0) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 98.3% (97.9 to 98.6) of those; for the 0.1% (0.1 to 0.3) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 50.0% (16.7 to 83.3). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds`), the kind is right for 97.8% (96.9 to 98.6); the page asserts a kind for 100.0% (100.0 to 100.0) and is right for 97.8% (96.9 to 98.6) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for –. A species is named on 17.3% (15.2 to 19.6) of these photos. The slot needs: species.bias_url (build 7 of the page); kinds.bias (build 7 of the page); fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).
